source: Budget Paper No. 1 2026-27, Statement 3, Table 3.3. Gross debt is the face value of AGS on issue at 30 June.
notes: Hand-maintained. Update at Budget (May) and MYEFO (Dec). The accrual rate is (end - start) over the seconds between fy_start and fy_end; gross debt grows faster than the underlying cash deficit because off-budget financing is also funded by AGS issuance.
